body.statement: Can the handle in \(\mathrm{def:rank-handle}\) replace the Bell-number family of label-refining partitions by representative bases and yield a deterministic \(2^{O(Kw)}\operatorname{poly}(R,L_{\mathrm{bits}})\)-time exact algorithm while preserving completed-label join compatibility, rational local-scope costs, and backpointer certification?
body.justification: A single-exponential dependence would determine whether exact covariance-aware design is practical beyond very small interaction width.
body.gap: Bodlaender et al. prove representative reduction for standard weighted connectivity extension queries, not simultaneous labeled connectivity with nonlinear bag charges and completed-label flags.
body.consumer: Larger sparse spatial networks would become certifiably optimizable without changing the covariance-scope criterion.
